correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction: passive compression sends n identical coherent training modes to |sqrt(n)α>; common uniform phase forces orthogonal fixed-total-number sectors. Each sector is a difference of two nonnegative rank-one operators of weights a_k,b_k and overlap q_k=(n/(n+1))^k. Determinant is -a_k b_k(1-q_k), and rank-two spectral formula gives sqrt((a_k-b_k)^2+4a_k b_k(1-q_k)); sum finite in trace norm since Σa_k=Σb_k=1. Correct equal-prior Helstrom risk =1/2−sum/4. Gaussian mixing gives geometric weights. For v=μ²/n, dominated convergence with geometric envelope and n(1−q_k)≤k gives stated polylogarithmic sqrt(n) coefficient. Independently computed n=1,v=1 P_err=0.21356409008208982 and n=10000 local coefficient 0.3374226648786782 versus limit 0.33681343818393766. Tests do not prove infinite sum or limit.
